proof_groups.proof_strategy: Split xizi_dll at the designated anchor, case-analyze the suffix, and use recursive xizi_dllseg folding plus the existing xizi_dll close structure to rebuild the post-state list after inserting the fresh node.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: The entry split and both return folds form one shared structural proof family for the same function; 3 witnesses are below the bound of 12, there are no dependencies, and a single group is exact minimal coverage.

natural_language_analysis.summary: All target VCs are semantically entailed by the accepted xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg model. The entry VC exposes the anchor-centered decomposition of the original circular list; the two return VCs fold exactly the updated links back into the requested sequence for nonempty and empty suffixes.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: xizi_dll head (nodes_before ++ linklist_pre :: nodes_after), plus permission-only ownership of linklist_node_pre.node_next and .node_prev.
vc_shape.pre_exists: The xizi_dll predicate hides the sentinel first/last links and the recursively linked nodes.
vc_shape.post_spatial: Either the empty-suffix decomposition ending linklist_pre at head, or the nonempty-suffix decomposition exposing old_next, its links, and the remaining segment; both retain the fresh-node permissions.
vc_shape.post_pure: Preserves the two non-null facts and additionally requires nodes_after = nil, or nodes_after = old_next :: rest with old_next <> 0.
vc_shape.post_exists: Empty case chooses old_prev and first; nonempty case chooses next_next, old_prev, last, first, old_next, and rest.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Open xizi_dll to obtain first/last, recursively traverse the segment corresponding to nodes_before, and destruct nodes_after. In the nil case instantiate the anchor successor with head; in the cons case instantiate old_next from the suffix head, next_next from its existential link, and rest from the suffix tail.
witnesses.space_plan: Use xizi_dll_open or unfold xizi_dll, then induct on nodes_before while unfolding xizi_dllseg. The residual anchor segment is unfolded once; if nodes_after is nonempty, unfold its next node once more. Frame the two permission-only fresh-node fields unchanged.
witnesses.pure_plan: The anchor and fresh-node non-null conditions are PreH1/PreH2. In the cons branch, old_next <> 0 is the non-null conjunct of the unfolded xizi_dllseg node. The suffix equality is supplied by the list case split; segment endpoint equalities in the nil branches come from the nil clause of xizi_dllseg.
witnesses.refinement_plan: No refinement or safeExec state is present.
premise_discharge: old_next <> 0 in the cons branch: non-null conjunct obtained by unfolding the suffix's first xizi_dllseg node
witnesses.grouping_reason: This is the decomposition half of the same segment transformation used by both return witnesses.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: Sentinel links, a prefix xizi_dllseg ending at linklist_pre, updated linklist_pre links to the fresh node, updated fresh-node links to old_next/linklist_pre, old_next links back to the fresh node, and the remaining suffix segment.
vc_shape.pre_pure: nodes_after = old_next :: rest; linklist_pre, linklist_node_pre, and old_next are non-null.
vc_shape.pre_exists: None beyond the universally quantified decomposition parameters already exposed by the entry assertion.
vc_shape.post_spatial: The full xizi_dll head (nodes_before ++ linklist_pre :: linklist_node_pre :: nodes_after), alternatively its sentinel-free segment form.
vc_shape.post_pure: No new pure proposition beyond normalizing nodes_after and xizi_double_link_insert_after_nodes.
vc_shape.post_exists: xizi_dll internally reuses the given first and last sentinel link values.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Rewrite nodes_after using PreH1 and unfold xizi_double_link_insert_after_nodes; the target sequence becomes nodes_before ++ linklist_pre :: linklist_node_pre :: old_next :: rest. Reuse first and last when closing xizi_dll.
witnesses.space_plan: Fold the existing prefix segment together with linklist_pre's updated links, the fresh node's links, old_next's updated predecessor link, and the rest segment. Then combine the folded full segment with the two sentinel links and apply the xizi_dll closing shape.
witnesses.pure_plan: PreH1 supplies the list rewrite. PreH2/PreH3/PreH4 supply non-null facts for the three newly folded nonempty nodes. Required node-versus-stop disequalities follow from the pairwise-separated owned link fields already present in the spatial precondition.
witnesses.refinement_plan: No refinement or safeExec state is present.
premise_discharge: nodes_after = old_next :: rest: direct from PreH1
linklist_pre <> 0, linklist_node_pre <> 0, old_next <> 0: direct from PreH2, PreH3, PreH4
folding endpoint equalities: supplied by the existing recursive segments and their nil endpoints
witnesses.grouping_reason: Nonempty-suffix instance of the common recursive segment-folding proof.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: Sentinel next/prev links, a prefix xizi_dllseg ending at linklist_pre, updated linklist_pre links to the fresh node, and fresh-node links back to linklist_pre and forward to head.
vc_shape.pre_pure: nodes_after = nil; linklist_pre and linklist_node_pre are non-null.
vc_shape.pre_exists: None beyond the universally quantified first and old_prev decomposition values.
vc_shape.post_spatial: The full xizi_dll head (nodes_before ++ linklist_pre :: linklist_node_pre :: nil), alternatively its sentinel-free segment form.
vc_shape.post_pure: No new pure proposition beyond normalizing the empty suffix and the case-specific sequence definition.
vc_shape.post_exists: xizi_dll internally reuses first and chooses linklist_node_pre as the last node.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Rewrite nodes_after to nil and unfold xizi_double_link_insert_after_nodes, obtaining nodes_before ++ linklist_pre :: linklist_node_pre :: nil; use first and linklist_node_pre for the xizi_dll existential endpoints.
witnesses.space_plan: Fold a two-node tail consisting of linklist_pre and the inserted node onto the prefix segment, with the inserted node ending at head. Combine the resulting full segment with the sentinel fields and close xizi_dll.
witnesses.pure_plan: PreH1 supplies the suffix rewrite and PreH2/PreH3 supply non-null conditions. Required node-versus-head disequalities follow from separation of the sentinel, anchor, and fresh-node link fields in the precondition; the terminal segment equalities follow from the nil xizi_dllseg clause.
witnesses.refinement_plan: No refinement or safeExec state is present.
premise_discharge: linklist_pre <> 0 and linklist_node_pre <> 0: direct from PreH2 and PreH3
terminal next=head and last=linklist_node_pre: exactly the updated link fields and nil-segment endpoint
witnesses.grouping_reason: Empty-suffix instance of the common recursive segment-folding proof.
